name: doctor
title_zh: 装完先跑一遍自检，确认危险命令真会被拦
tagline_zh: 装 Anchorwatch 最怕的是装了个寂寞——工具链缺了、配置没生效，危险命令照样放行。它替你逐项验。
tagline_en: Installing Anchorwatch and hoping it works? This checks every required tool, finds your config, then fires a real.
desc_en: Verify the Anchorwatch installation — required tools (bash, grep, a JSON parser), config discovery, and a self-test that a dangerous command is denied.
why_zh: 不是看配置文件说『应该安全』，而是用一条真实危险命令做端到端验证，让拦截机制当场现形。
why_en: It doesn't trust the config file—it runs an actual dangerous command end-to-end, forcing the deny mechanism to prove itself live.
limit_zh: 只验证 Anchorwatch 自身安装，不检查你写的规则是否完备；需要本机有 bash。
limit_en: Only validates Anchorwatch's own install, not your rule coverage. Needs bash, grep, and a JSON parser on the machine; it won't install them for you.
title_en: Post-install self-test that proves dangerous commands get.
